verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no translation option or endpoint for Scribe transcripts. docs-17 covers automatic detection of the source language, which is not translation. docs-8 describes a general natural-language edit instruction returned as 'edited_transcript', but it is never documented as translating into another language. That makes it an adjacent feature, not the named capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a transcript translated to another language through a documented option or endpoint
